module: "Playbook Unlocked Missions Viewer" window associated with editor_missionPlaybook. After each playbook step, it sorts the career missions into three lists (startable, visible, invisible) according to gameplay_missions_unlocks.isMissionStartable / isMissionVisible and stores them in resultData.unlockedMissions. The window displays three columns for the current page and colors green the missions that became startable at this step (unlockChange.byId).
notes: The window is only drawn if "Mission Playbook" is visible.
Bug: M.onEditorRegisterPreferences is assigned to an undefined global variable (nil).
A mission that is "visible" but not startable goes in visible; a mission that is startable but not visible goes in invisible.

show.desc: Shows the "Mission Playbook" and "Playbook Unlocked Missions Viewer" windows.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: draws the three mission columns for book.results[book.page].

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the window (500x500) and the "Missions" menu entry.

onPlaybookLogAfterStep.desc: Hook emitted after each playbook instruction: adds resultData.unlockedMissions = {startable, visible, invisible} (lists of ids).

resultData.desc: Result of the step, modified in place.
